mapper.select: SELECT FROM exam_session WHERE exam_id = #{examId} AND user_id = #{userId}
SELECT FROM exam_session WHERE exam_id = #{examId} AND user_id = #{userId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO exam_session (exam_id, user_id, started_at, status) SELECT e.exam_id, s.user_id, NOW(), 'IN_PROGRESS' FROM exam_info e JOIN exam_student s ON s.exam_id = e.exam_id WHERE e.exam_id = #{examId} AND s.user_id = #{userId} AND e.status = '0' AND e.published_at IS NOT NULL AND e.start_time <= NOW() AND e.end_time > NOW()
mapper.update: UPDATE exam_session SET status = #{status}, submitted_at = NOW() WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND status = 'IN_PROGRESS'
mapper.select: SELECT sess.* FROM exam_session sess WHERE sess.session_id > #{afterId} AND sess.status IN ('SUBMITTED', 'AUTO_SUBMITTED', 'GRADED') AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM exam_question_snapshot q LEFT JOIN exam_answer_record a ON a.exam_id = q.exam_id AND a.question_id = q.question_id AND a.user_id = sess.user_id WHERE q.exam_id = sess.exam_id AND (a.record_id IS NULL OR (a.graded_at IS NULL AND (a.answer IS NULL OR a.answer REGEXP '^[[:space:]]*$' OR q.question_type IN ('SINGLE_CHOICE', 'MULTI_CHOICE', 'JUDGE', 'PYTHON')))) ) ORDER BY sess.session_id LIMIT 100
mapper.update: UPDATE exam_session sess JOIN exam_info e ON e.exam_id = sess.exam_id SET sess.status = 'AUTO_SUBMITTED', sess.submitted_at = IF(e.duration_minutes=0,e.end_time,LEAST(e.end_time,DATE_ADD(sess.started_at,INTERVAL e.duration_minutes MINUTE))) WHERE sess.status = 'IN_PROGRESS' AND (e.end_time <= NOW() OR (e.duration_minutes>0 AND DATE_ADD(sess.started_at,INTERVAL e.duration_minutes MINUTE)<=NOW()))
